integrity: Closed CDF, moment integral and asymptotic coefficients are proved by an exact shortest-path reduction and radial-kite area integration; finite numerical checks support but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: One fixed vertex, uniformly distributed surface endpoint on a regular tetrahedron, intrinsic path metric; not the distance between two independently uniform endpoints or an irregular tetrahedron; no independent historical-priority confirmation.
title: Exact intrinsic vertex-distance law of the regular tetrahedral surface
